title: streaming: add abandon-detection and resume-token reconciliation for client disconnects (openai-compat)
author: Maya Ortiz
description: Motivation: Intermittent client disconnects (mobile, flaky networks) were leaving server-side streaming sessions in a 'limbo' state for the full session TTL. That increased memory/KV-cache pressure and made reconnection semantics brittle when clients tried to resume. This PR introduces an explicit abandon-detection path plus a resume-token reconciliation step in the OpenAI compatibility layer to make reconnects robust and resource-efficient. Overview of changes: 1) server-side abandon detector: heuristics to mark sessions as abandoned after N consecutive failed keepalive windows (configurable), with a fast-path reclamation for short-lived 'ghost' sessions; 2) resume-token reconciliation: when a client reconnects with a resume token, we now validate continuity (prefix match of last committed token sequence), fall back to synthetic soft-cancel if mismatch, and accept partial resumes when the token window is older than retention but alignment is possible; 3) metrics/observability: added abandon_count, resume_reconcile_hits/misses, and a debug trace emitted on mismatch for postmortem; 4) API & docs: small extension to the OpenAI-compat streaming handshake to expose a Resume-Accepted header and doc updates describing the semantics and recommended client retry behavior. This PR intentionally avoids changing token formats or client protocol fields except for the optional header (backwards compatible). Testing notes: unit tests cover heuristic edge cases, an integration test simulates flapping clients and validates cache reclamation, and e2e tests verify resume acceptance scenarios. Related issues: linear ENG-5421.

review_thread: Ethan Bloom: The abandon detector heuristics look good, but can we make the default window shorter for mobile-heavy tenants? Suggested to make default 2 windows instead of 3.
Maya Ortiz: I pushed a config flag and added a note in docs. Default remains 3 to be conservative, but tenant override is now available via runtime config.

Sofia Li: The resume-token reconciliation is clever. Two nit requests: 1) add an explicit debug log when we fall back to synthetic soft-cancel, 2) add a unit test for token prefix mismatch with same suffix length.
Maya Ortiz: Added the debug log and the additional unit. Also added a metric for reconciliation misses.
Arjun Patel: Integration test flake observed locally; CI shows a transient failure in TestFlap_Graceful then passed on rerun. Approving after CI green.
Ethan Bloom: Approving. Please squash merge and include a short release note about the header (Resume-Accepted) and config knobs.
Maya Ortiz: Addressed review comments and rebased on main to pick up the recent lint rule change. Ready to merge.
diff_snippets:
--- a/docs/openai-compat/stream-resume.md
+++ b/docs/openai-compat/stream-resume.md
@@ -1,3 +1,12 @@
+Resume semantics: Clients may present a resume token after reconnecting. Servers will attempt a prefix match against the last committed token sequence. On mismatch, the server will perform a synthetic soft-cancel and surface Resume-Accepted=false. Clients should re-issue the request from the last confirmed token or start a fresh session.
+Configuration: runtime.abandon.window=3 (default)
+Metrics: stream.resume_reconcile_hits/misses, stream.abandon_count
+Best practices: exponential backoff + jitter on reconnects.
release_notes: minor: Add abandon detection and resume-token reconciliation to improve streaming reconnect behavior. Exposes optional Resume-Accepted header. Configurable abandon window (runtime.abandon.window).
